name: Deleting a repo's only GitHub token clears the assignment; the repo stays broken-but-readable throughout
description: Modeled on 02/04/07: navigate to the seeded repo's settings page, go to Settings → GitHub Tokens, delete the seeded token, and confirm the PATCH that follows actually clears the repo's assignment. Originally this flow asserted the amber 'no token' badge only APPEARS after deletion — but the seeded `demo` token has no stored PAT value (server/db/seed.ts), and per the final-review fix a repo ASSIGNED to a valueless token is exactly as broken as one with no token at all (RepoWithToken.github_token_configured gates the badge/banner together with github_token_id). So the badge is present from the very first load, before any deletion, making 'badge appears' vacuously true. What deletion actually changes is the ASSIGNMENT itself: the repo settings picker shows the selected label 'demo' beforehand and reverts to its unselected placeholder afterward, once the FK really nulls github_token_id server-side. This flow asserts THAT transition instead. Scoped to what is reachable offline: reassigning a token would call POST /repos/:id/github-token → probeToken → listPullRequests, which needs a resolvable PAT and live GitHub access that e2e/ deliberately has neither of (see e2e/INSIGHTS.md), so that half of the flow is verified manually against real GitHub instead. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api is the only repo and its github_token_id points at the seeded `demo` token — guaranteed by the e2e-web.yml workflow's fresh seed; run locally against a clean DB (see e2e/README.md).

steps.label: load the app root
initial data fetch settles

the amber badge is ALREADY showing on first load — the seeded demo token has no stored value, which is exactly as broken as no assignment at all
open the repo settings page via the sidebar nav
navigate to /repos/:repoId/settings
repo settings page renders the token section
the picker shows the seeded token 'demo' selected (assigned, though not configured)
load Settings → GitHub Tokens
github-tokens settings route reached
the GitHub Tokens section renders
the seeded token is listed
the token shows a repo count of 1
start deleting the demo token

cmd: 1 repository will be left without a token
steps.label: the orphan warning names 1 repository before any deletion happens
confirm the deletion
the delete mutation settles
return to the repo's PR list via the sidebar nav
navigate to /repos/:repoId/pulls
the amber badge is still showing — unchanged from before deletion, now for the other reason (no assignment at all instead of an unconfigured one)
